name: MoltNode by Chord
description: Hosted MCP server by Chord, no account or API key. Read 31 blockchains over JSON-RPC (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Solana, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Sui and more) and get best-route DEX swap quotes with the unsigned transaction, approval and simulation via Chord. Tools: list_chains, rpc_call, get_block_number, get_balance, chord_find_token, chord_swap_quote, send_raw_transaction. Non-custodial: tools return unsigned transactions for the user's wallet to sign, and send_raw_transaction only broadcasts an already-signed transaction. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.tuantqse90/moltnode.
author: Chord
